senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (ए) (रगे) (रगति)
To suspect, to doubt, to fear.
r. 10th cl. (रागयति)
1 To taste.
2 To obtain.
(इ) रगि r. 1st cl. (रंगति)
To go, to move.

m. (-गः)
1 Colour, hue, tint, dye.
2 Affection, prepossession, love, desire.
3 Mental affection in general, as sorrow, joy, &c.
4 Envy, impatience of another's success.
5 A mode of music; of which six are enumerated, viz. Bhairava, Mālava, Sāraṅga, Hindola, Vasanta, Dīpaka, and Megha; they are personified in poetry and mythology.
6 A king, a sovereign.
7 The Raja Guṇa, the property or quality of passion.
8 Greediness, cupidity.
9 Colouring, painting, dying.
f. (-गा)
A sort of grain, commonly Raggy, much cultivated in the south of India, (Eleusine corocana, or Cynosurus corocanus.)
E.
रञ्ज to colour, &c., aff. घञ्.

m. (-र्णः)
1 A name of KĀMA.
2 A tree yielding an astringent resin or extract, the wood of which is used in dying, (Mimosa catechu.)
3 Red lead.
4 The red powder thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the vernal festival named Holī.
E.
राग passion or colour, and चर्ण powder.

m. (-न्नः)
RĀMA.
E.
राग, and छन्न covered.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Colouring.
2 Inspiring passion.
f. (-दा)
Crystal.
E.
राग colour, दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-ज्जुः)
The deity of love, KĀMA.
E.
राग passion, desire, and रज्जु a rope.

f. (-ता)
The wife of KĀMADEVA.
E.
राग passion, desire, and लता a creeping plant.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Coloured.
2 Impassioned.
E.
राग, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
राग passion, and वृन्त the stalk of a flower, the support.

m. (-वः)
A sweetmeat^1 of unripe mangoes dressed with treacle and oil.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The thread or string of a balance.
2 A string or thread of silk.
3 Any coloured thread or string.
E.
राग colour, and सूत्र a thread.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Affected by passion.
2 Coloured.
E.
राग, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
1 One who excites hopes and disappoints them.
2 Who or what is an object of affection.
E.
राग, and अर्ह fit.

m. (-निः)
A Jina or Jaina saint.
E.
राग passion, अश to throw (away), अनि aff.

m. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
1 Passionate, impassioned.
2 Colouring, painting.
3 Coloured, dyed.
m. (-गी)
1 A dyer, a painter.
2 A libertine, a lover.
f. (-णी)
1 A shrewd and intriguing woman.
2 A modification of a musical mode, of which five are assigned to each mode; in mythology, personified as a female, and the wife of the Rāga.
E.
राग passion, and इनि aff., or रञ्ज to colour, &c., and धिनुण् aff.
